title: Introduce longitudinal calibration reporter and calibration-smoke CI gate
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds a per-prompt longitudinal calibration reporter (ECE + reliability diagram artifacts) and a CI smoke gate that fails when ECE regresses beyond configured thresholds. Includes docs and test coverage.
description:
Context: We need a lightweight, automated guard that can detect calibration regressions in prompt sets that matter for downstream scoring, reranking, and decisioning. Motivation: Token-level and top-k accuracy metrics have been monitored for a while, but we lack an actionable calibration signal (confidence vs. correctness) surfaced in CI. This PR introduces a longitudinal calibration reporter that computes per-prompt and cohort-level Expected Calibration Error (ECE), emits reliability diagram PNGs and an artifacts JSON, and wires a CI smoke gate that fails builds when ECE increases beyond tolerances.

What this change does (summary):
- Adds eval-harness/src/eval/calibration.py: implementation of ECE, bucketed and isotonic variants, per-prompt aggregation and cohort rollups.
- Adds a lightweight reporter that stores time-series of ECE for configured prompt-sets and writes a small index.json for artifacts.
- Adds CI integration: .github/workflows/calibration-smoke.yml which runs on merge and on PRs touching eval configs; the job compares current ECE to the baseline stored in artifacts to decide pass/fail.
- Adds unit and integration tests under eval-harness/tests/test_calibration.py and a smoke fixture that replays a stable prompt-set.
- Adds docs at eval-harness/docs/calibration.md describing metric definitions, thresholds, and troubleshooting.

Design and thresholds:
- We compute ECE with 10 equal-width buckets by default. Two comparison rules for the CI gate: absolute_threshold (fail if new ECE > 0.05) and delta_threshold (fail if delta > 0.015 relative to baseline). Both are configurable in eval-harness/config/calibration.yml and can be overridden per-prompt-set.
- To reduce noise, the CI gate uses a rolling baseline: the canonical baseline is the median of the last 5 committed baselines; a Canary mode can be enabled to be stricter (delta 0.01).

Testing and validation:
- Added synthetic tests that exercise perfect calibration, under-confidence, and over-confidence cases.
- Added a reproducible fixture that pins RNG seeds and exports artifact snapshots used by the CI job for deterministic comparisons.
- Ran the new CI job against main and observed baseline ECE for the flagship prompt-set (conversational-summary-set) of 0.028; feature branch ECE was 0.026 which passed.

Operational notes:
- Artifacts are small JSON + PNGs and will be retained in GH artifact storage for 30 days by default; we added a flag to export to S3 for longer retention.
- New config file supports per-team thresholds and whitelisting prompt-sets for CI enforcement.

Rollout plan:
- Merge behind feature flag; enable for 'core' prompt-sets first (conversational-summary-set, embeddings-regression-set) for two weeks; if noise is acceptable, expand to more prompt-sets.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of ECE and reliability diagram exporter
- [x] Config and CI workflow
- [x] Unit and integration tests
- [x] Docs and runbook notes
- [x] Manual baseline collection and Canary run

Commits: See commit messages below for granular changes.

Why this is different from previous work: Many prior PRs introduced stability and drift detectors; this PR focuses specifically on confidence calibration (ECE) and makes calibration a first-class CI signal with artifacts that help engineering teams triage whether increased error is due to model score shifts or prompt-level distribution changes.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: ECE sensitive to small sample sizes — mitigated by requiring minimum examples per prompt-set (configurable, default 200).
- Risk: Flaky baselines due to RNG or data ordering — mitigated by pinned seeds and deterministic fixtures.

If you want to run locally: python -m eval_harness.eval.calibration --prompt-set conversational-summary-set --out artifacts/calibration-local.json

review_conversation: Marco Diaz: Nice incremental design. Can we avoid baking 10 buckets as a constant? Suggest making buckets configurable and add a test for odd bucket counts.
Priya Menon (author): Good point — made buckets configurable in calibration.yml and added tests for 7 and 11 buckets.
Aisha Khan: A couple of nits on docs: add a troubleshooting section on reliability diagrams and include example PNGs inline.
Priya Menon: Added the troubleshooting section and two sample diagrams. Also added guidance on interpreting spikes in ECE.
Ravi Patel: CI workflow looks good. One ask: gate should never block hotfix release pipelines. I added an exception to ignore 'release/hotfix/*' branches in the workflow.
Priya Menon: Acknowledged and implemented the exception. Thanks for the review.
